body:
Parent: #1911
Depends on: #2116, #2117, #2118, #2119, #1909, #2104

## 原子目标

把source/metadata/Git/dependency conflict facts与用户closed decisions封存为immutable resolution plan，冻结exact base/local/server coordinates、selected actions、expected revisions与result candidates。Plan执行前任一coordinate/identity/permission/Git/dependency漂移都必须失效。本issue只生成/验证resolution plans，不执行server/local写入或提供UI。

## 必须交付

1. Plan输入只接受verified#2116 conflict items、#2117 source candidates、#2118 metadata candidates、#2119 Git facts与#2104 original sync plan refs/digests。
2. 每个conflict item exact-one记录selected action、automatic/manual/rejected provenance、affectedranges/fields/identities与expected result digest；未选择/unknown/wildcard action fail closed。
3. Plan冻结site/vault/article/operation、base/local/server revisions/digests、Git worktree/index/operation state、permissions/lifecycle/schema/dependencies与plan expiry。
4. Automatic candidates必须来自#2117/#2118 verified non-overlap outputs；manual actions只能使用#2116允许的closed actions。
5. “接受全部本地/服务端”只能展开成逐item closed decisions并重新验证authority，不能作为绕过rights/publication/dependencies的全局flag。
6. 生成新的resolution operation identity和expected server/local coordinates；不修改original plan或conflict evidence。
7. Execute前independent verifier重新读取current server/local/Git/dependency facts，任何revision/content/schema/permission/marker/operation drift立即标stale并拒绝。
8. Plan content-addressed、append-only，包含action order、all-or-nothing groups、server/local expected outputs、recovery prerequisites、user confirmation evidence与content digest。
9. Duplicate confirmation/request幂等；不同decision set生成新plan，不覆盖旧plan/history。
10. Plan不能包含任意source code、shell、Git command、URL/path write或untyped executable payload。
11. Failure reason精确定位stale field/item/ref，不自动rebase、replan或改选winner。

## 固定约束

- 不执行server writer/local materialization。
- 不实现recovery journals或UI。
- 不修改source/metadata merge结果。
- 不允许AI/mtime/two-way自动决策。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- all conflicts resolved正向；
- missing/duplicate/unknown decision；
- accept-all-local越权；
- source candidate未verified；
- server revision drift；
- local source changed；
- Git HEAD/index/marker/operation drift；
- permission/lifecycle/schema/dependency drift；
- stale plan自动rebase；
- duplicate confirmation/idempotency；
- old plan被覆盖；
- executable/shell/path payload；
- plan/result/action tamper。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Resolution plan冻结全部conflict decisions与three-way/Git/authority coordinates。
- [ ] 任一current fact漂移使旧planstale并在写前拒绝。
- [ ] Accept-all/AI/mtime/two-way不能绕过closed actions与server authority。
- [ ] Plans immutable、versioned、idempotent、可独立验证且保留历史。
- [ ] 本PR不执行写入或提供UI。

## 非目标

- 不实现conflict taxonomy/merge/Git facts。
- 不执行sync/recovery。
- 不提供conflict UI。
- 不执行terminal E2E。

Immediate WIP consumer handoff: source `bb49a4c1f` on `codex/article-vault-git-resolution-recovery-2119-20261008`, over published Git facts `0b3060cd5` and fixed original c0c32cb. Shared APIs now available: `ArticleVaultResolutionPlan`, `VaultResolutionDecision`, `VaultResolutionConfirmation`, `VaultResolutionExpectedOutput`, `ArticleVaultResolutionPlanner.Build/VerifyCurrent/Serialize/Deserialize/RequireExecutionAdmission`; recovery descriptors: `ArticleVaultRecoveryJournal`, `VaultRecoveryReference`, `VaultRecoveryBackupPolicy`, `ArticleVaultRecoveryJournalVerifier.ValidateStructure/VerifyHistory/RequireRecoveryAdmission/Serialize/Deserialize`.

These are real limited source contracts, not successful commands or qualification. Resolution V1 currently admits only actual #2118 Title/Summary/Slug scalar-metadata candidate provenance (or closed cancellation) verified against original plan inputs and bytes. Source candidates/manual replacements/portable mapping return explicit missing-reader reasons. Prepared is a sealed proposal: RequireExecutionAdmission always refuses the absent #2105 resolution bridge; original blocked plan is not modified. RequireRecoveryAdmission likewise refuses absent #2106/#2107 actual materializer/operation bridge. Checkpoint refs alone are never physical receipt/encryption/cleanup proof.

Shared Release build passed SDK10.0.401; behavioral tests and exact-SHA governance are underway. No shared registration/project/authority bindings or original-owned source edited. Integration owner must register new paths and integrate the matching current docs; UI consumers may render these states and precise reasons, but must preserve the admission refusals. New source is not product/platform acceptance.
